1 (Currently Amended): A column assembly comprising: a chromatography column comprising a compliant seal defining a fluid passage configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit without the use of a ferrule or a threaded compression screw, wherein the compliant seal is configured to deform and maintain a seal under varying pressure conditions.

3 (Currently Amended): The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the fluid passage includes a tapered portion configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit, wherein the tapered portion is configured to mate with a tapered fluid conduit at a diameter of less than __0.050__ inches.

7 (Currently Amended): The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the fluid passage includes a tapered portion configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit, the tapered portion being defined in relation to the compliant seal.

9 (Currently Amended): The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the compliant seal is formed of a polyimide, polyether-ether-ketone, __a thermoplastic elastomer, or__ a deformable metal.

10 (Currently Amended): The column assembly of claim 1, further comprising a seal retainer that is removable to allow for removal and replacement of the compliant seal, wherein the seal retainer is configured to retain the compliant seal in an assembled position within the fluid passage.

11 (Currently Amended): The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the compliant seal is configured to maintain a seal against a tapered fluid conduit at pressures up to __30,000__ psi.
